jobs.descriptionHtml:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

Harvey is transforming how the world's leading professional services organizations work with AI. Security is fundamental to that mission: our customers include some of the world's largest and most sophisticated enterprises, and they expect Harvey to be a leader not only in AI, but in how AI can be deployed securely.

We're looking for an Advisory CISO based in New York City to serve as a senior security leader at the intersection of our customers, go-to-market organization, and engineering teams.

Reporting directly to Harvey's CISO, you'll represent Harvey's security strategy with CISOs and other technology leaders across the region. You'll partner closely with Sales and Customer Success on strategic opportunities, helping customers understand how Harvey approaches security, AI risk, architecture, and deployment. Just as importantly, you'll bring what you learn from those conversations back into Harvey, working with Security, Product, and Engineering to influence our roadmap and ensure we're solving the security problems that matter most to our customers.

This isn't a traditional sales engineering or compliance role. We're looking for an experienced security leader who can move comfortably between a customer CISO conversation and a technical discussion with Harvey's engineers.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as a trusted security advisor to CISOs, CIOs, and technology leaders at Harvey's customers and prospects across the region.

  • Partner with GTM leadership on strategic opportunities where security, architecture, AI risk, or customer trust are critical to adoption.

  • Work directly with Harvey's Security, Product, Legal and Engineering teams to translate customer requirements and emerging risks into product and security priorities.

  • Develop and communicate Harvey's point of view on securing enterprise AI, including architecture, deployment models, data protection, identity, AI security, and emerging threats.

  • Represent Harvey externally through executive briefings, customer forums, industry events, and security thought leadership.

  • Help Harvey anticipate how regional and industry-specific regulatory, security, and data requirements will shape enterprise AI adoption.

What You Have

  • You have operated as a CISO, Deputy CISO, senior security executive, Field CISO, or similarly senior technical security leader in a sophisticated technology environment. You have enough technical depth to engage credibly with security architects and engineers, but can also advise executives and navigate complex enterprise buying decisions.

  • You've built or operated real security programs and understand how modern software and cloud platforms are secured. Experience with AI security, enterprise SaaS, regulated industries, or complex enterprise technology environments is particularly valuable.

  • Most importantly, you're a builder and advisor. You can establish credibility with a customer, identify what their concerns reveal about the market, and turn those insights into action across GTM, Security, Product, and Engineering.

Compensation

$272,000 - $374,000

Depending on your location, an Applicant Privacy Notice may apply to you. You can find all of our Applicant Privacy Notices here.

If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

 

Role Overview

As Harvey grows, we’re taking on increasingly complex, cross-functional programs that cut across teams and require dedicated end-to-end ownership. These range from opening new entities and markets, to M&A and integration work, to evolving the systems and providers that support our employees around the world.

 

You’ll run point on some of our key operational initiatives: bringing structure to ambiguous problems, building the plan, coordinating work across functions, and driving decisions and execution.

 

This is a hands-on program management role — you’ll work closely with functional experts, but you’re expected to get into the substance, develop a point of view, and personally step into gaps wherever needed to drive the program forward.

 

What You'll Do

  • Own complex, high-priority programs from initial planning through execution and handoff, including M&A initiatives spanning diligence through integration, geographic expansion and entity formation, and major operational transitions.

  • Build and drive the program plan, translating a messy objective into clear requirements, workstreams, owners, dependencies, readiness gates, and decisions; proactively surface risks, resolve blockers, and adjust the plan as facts change.

  • Connect the dots across functions. Partner deeply with People, Recruiting, Finance, Legal, Tax, IT, and other teams to understand how decisions in one workstream affect another, identify gaps before they become problems, and make sure the right people are involved at the right moments.

  • Build repeatable infrastructure as we scale, turning what we learn from each program into better templates, SOPs, playbooks, and operating processes for the next one.

  • Drive critical decisions forward. Develop a point of view, frame tradeoffs, bring the right stakeholders together, and ensure decisions translate into execution.

  • Own program communication and change management, from crisp executive updates and decision points to clear, thoughtful communications for employees affected by a change.

  • Keep the employee experience at the center. Make sure operational complexity behind the scenes translates into a coordinated, thoughtful experience for employees — particularly during high-change moments like integrating a new team, entering a new market, or transitioning employment infrastructure.

What You Have

  • 7+ years of experience leading complex, cross-functional programs in fast-moving environments, including meaningful experience supporting M&A transactions and integrations across multiple stages of the lifecycle

  • A hands-on operating style and strong bias toward action. You dig into the substance, step into gaps, and do what’s needed to keep complex work moving. You’re comfortable figuring things out as you go and have good judgment about what requires deeper diligence versus what simply needs to get done.

  • Strong stakeholder management and judgment, with the ability to align specialists and senior leaders across functions without formal authority.

  • Clear, direct executive communication. You can distill a complicated program into the decisions, risks, and tradeoffs that matter and communicate them appropriately to everyone from executives to affected employees.

  • Strong AI fluency. You use AI as a core part of how you work — to move faster, synthesize information, work through ambiguity, and increase the quality and leverage of your output.

 

Compensation

$120,000 - $200,000 USD

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As the founding APAC SMB Sales Manager at Harvey, you will shape the future of our Small and Medium-sized Business (SMB) go-to-market strategy. You’ll build, coach and develop a high-performing team of Account Executives while also rolling up your sleeves to engage directly with clients. Beyond hitting ambitious sales targets, you’ll establish the cultural and operational foundations of our SMB sales team: building playbooks, creating scalable best practices, and setting expectations that drive both accountability and collaboration.

In this role, you’ll build feedback loops with Product, Marketing, and Customer Success that inform product development, pipeline generation, and the SMB customer lifecycle. Success will mean using data to forecast accurately, improve team performance and prioritise accounts where Harvey can deliver the most impact.

We are looking for a highly analytical self-starter who can navigate ambiguity, operate in a fast-paced environment, and solve complex problems with limited oversight. Ideal candidates will have superb core sales skills, experience scaling high-velocity teams and mentoring colleagues, outstanding communication skills, and an affinity for understanding customer needs.

What You’ll Do

  • Hire & lead a team of analytical, solution-based, SMB software sales professionals to achieve ARR targets through high velocity net new logo deals

  • Drive recruiting for your team, including refining the ideal candidate profile, participating in sourcing, and interviewing candidates

  • Own managing and reporting on your book of business, including accurate revenue forecasting and pipeline maintenance.

  • Coach and develop SMB account executives to promote career growth

  • Refine our SMB sales playbook to enable all sellers to better deliver results

  • Work cross-functionally across the organisation to build effective sales processes and solutions that meet the needs of Harvey’s clients.

What You Have

  • Extensive tech sales experience. Ideally closing new business at the Mid Market or Enterprise level; Minimum 2+ years of people management experience building, training and coaching a high-performing sales team.

  • Experience operating in an early stage, high-growth environment. Demonstrated ability to design and improve systems from scratch

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to a variety of audiences.

Additional Information

  • Location: Sydney, NSW (Hybrid with flexibility)

  • Work eligibility: Must have valid Australian work rights; Harvey does not currently offer visa sponsorship for this role

What We Offer

  • Structured hybrid working arrangement: 3 days in our Sydney office, 2 days working from home

  • Health Coverage: Fully covered private hospital insurance, plus extras for dental, optical, physio, mental health, and more.

  • Family & Fertility Support: Support for fertility treatments, adoption, and surrogacy through Carrot.

  • Retirement & Security: Comprehensive coverage designed to support your long-term well-being.

  • Paid Leave: Paid annual leave, sick leave, and fully paid parental leave for all parents.

  • Wellness & Perks: Daily in-office lunch, wellness memberships through Wellhub, and monthly commuting support.

  • Professional Development: Annual support for courses, certifications, conferences, and books.

  • Remote Work Allowance: Monthly support for home office, internet, and phone expenses.

  • Harvey Holiday: After four years, enjoy a four-week paid sabbatical to rest, travel, or explore new experiences.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

We're looking for a Senior Manager, Product Design to lead the Admin & Enterprise Platform

Admin is how firm leaders and innovation teams set up and run Harvey inside their organizations: workflow configuration, permissions and governance, and visibility into how the product is being used. These are the people who decide whether Harvey stays at an account, and Admin is where they see what they're getting from it.

Enterprise Platform owns the context and knowledge layer every Harvey product builds from: document management integrations, Vault, connectors, and the research hub. A general model can reason about law, but it can't reach a firm's precedent or matter files that a lawyer would actually cite. It also can't be trusted with them by default, so this team owns how that context is secured and permissioned. What the rest of the product can do is empowered by what this context layer can reach, and design decides whether a lawyer can tell what Harvey found and what it missed.

You'll report to the VP Design as a foundational member of the Design leadership team, with portfolio-wide impact on how our product, team, and culture scale. You'll set the operating bar for how we work, and lay foundations for the product that hold for years.

What You'll Do

Own Admin and Enterprise as a product

  • Drive strategy and execution for the Admin & Enterprise platforms in close partnership with Product and Engineering, rooted in how champions actually run Harvey inside their firms.

  • Work directly with customers, research, and usage data to find where champions lose time or lose confidence, and design the workflow configuration, knowledge management, and visibility experiences that fix it.

  • Tie your roadmap to customer outcomes: faster rollout, wider adoption, and evidence of ROI our champions can take to their own leadership.

Build and lead the team

  • Build, grow, and develop a team of high-craft ICs across systems, product, and prototyping from a small starting footprint.

  • Own org design, resourcing, and prioritization across four surfaces with very different rhythms, including the conference deadlines that don't move.

  • Give strategic, systems-level feedback on end-to-end flows, not just screens.

Lead across the org

  • Partner with design, product, and engineering leaders to evolve how Harvey builds, and represent Platform in high-stakes conversations with executives and customers.

  • Establish how we make design decisions in high-trust, high-stakes environments where clarity and accuracy are non-negotiable.

  • Be a foundational member of the Design leadership team and help set the operating model the rest of the org runs on.

What You Have

  • 8-10+ years in Product Design, with 5+ years directly managing product designers.

  • Experience designing and shipping AI-powered or highly technical products.

  • A strong portfolio showing leadership of complex products from concept through launch, with clear impact on users and the business.

  • Ideal experience in building B2B enterprise products.

  • Fluency with AI tooling in your own practice, and a real opinion about how it changes design work.

  • Proven experience leading design strategy and execution alongside Product and Engineering.

  • Demonstrated ability to define and ship high-quality experiences in complex, ambiguous problem spaces.

  • Excellent judgment about when to go deep, when to delegate, and when to push.

  • Exceptional communication skills and the ability to influence senior stakeholders, internally and in front of customers.

  • Deep commitment to growing people and raising the craft bar across a team.

  • Comfort operating in fast-moving environments with evolving priorities.

  • Empathy for users, teammates, and the realities of high-stakes professional work.

  • A growth mindset, resilience, and a bias toward learning through doing.

  • Strong people leadership instincts with a bias toward clarity, empathy, and accountability.

Compensation

$235,500 - $325,000 USD

We're looking for a Senior Manager, Product Design to lead the Admin & Enterprise Platform

Admin is how firm leaders and innovation teams set up and run Harvey inside their organizations: workflow configuration, permissions and governance, and visibility into how the product is being used. jobs.title: Manager, Customer Experience
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

Harvey is looking for a Customer Experience (CX) Manager to lead a high-performing support team serving lawyers and professional services teams. Our customers hold their own work to a high standard of accuracy and timeliness, and expect the same from our support. How well your region runs is one of the biggest levers Harvey has on what customers actually experience when they need help. Reporting to the Head of CX, you'll drive operational excellence and accountability across Harvey's global support organization.

You'll balance strategic oversight with hands-on execution. This is a role for a leader who thrives in motion: proactive, decisive, and deeply motivated by achieving results through your team. You'll inherit a metric set and processes that need to be better, and we expect you to diagnose what's broken and fix it without being asked.

You'll also be one of five CX Managers across the globe, and that peer group is where our operating standard gets set. You're expected to trade what's working across regions and push for the changes you think we should make everywhere, shaping the culture and cadence of a growing support organization.

What You'll Do

  • Run day-to-day support delivery for your region: queue and coverage, triage and handoff, and escalation judgment, measured by First Response Time, Resolution Time, QA, and cSAT. When a number moves, you find the root cause and fix it or scale it.

  • Set individual performance expectations and stay close enough to the work to spot drift early. Coach against QA results in the moment, and move to a documented plan only when coaching hasn't landed.

  • Own escalations end to end: triage and severity judgment, customer communication through to resolution, and bug reports Engineering can act on without a follow-up thread. Partner with Product, Engineering, and Go-to-Market to turn recurring escalations into fixes.

  • Take part in the on-call rotation for customer-impacting incidents, owning the coordination of response and customer communication strategy while an incident is live.

  • Drive adoption of the AI tools and systems we provide across triage, drafting, deflection, and QA, and pressure-test what CX Ops ships against real queue conditions.

  • Track how your region performs against the other four, bring what's working to your peers, adopt what's working in theirs, and propose the practices you think should apply globally.

  • Forecast coverage and staffing against volume, and flag gaps before they have impact.

  • Hire, onboard, and develop team members to ensure readiness for future growth and evolving support needs.

What You Have

  • 8+ years in customer support or customer experience, including 4+ years managing teams in a high-volume environment serving enterprise customers.

  • Comfortable operating at Harvey's pace, not a typical enterprise pace. This is consistently the hardest bar for otherwise-strong support managers to clear.

  • A deep focus on the customer, and real satisfaction in solving the problems that make their work harder than it needs to be.

  • You are genuinely invested in developing your team, and you know a high bar is part of that.

  • You manage close to the work. You know what your team's tickets actually look like, not just what the dashboard says.

  • A change you made to how a support team works that produced a step change, not an incremental gain. You saw the leverage point others in the seat missed.

  • Ownership of a metric set (FRT, TTR, cSAT, QA, backlog, deflection): what drives each one, what to change when one slips, and the ability to build your own reporting. We use Zendesk, Salesforce, Omni, and Snowflake.

  • You understand enterprise escalations, from severity judgment through the customer conversation, and can work one yourself: reproduce the issue, read error logs, and troubleshoot API, authentication, and AI output quality issues well enough to brief Engineering accurately.

  • You can take a process improvement from idea to shipped yourself, and you know which ones to handover to someone on your team instead.

  • Day-to-day proficiency using AI tools in a production support workflow, not experimentation, and a concrete point of view on how AI is changing what a support team should look like.

  • Admin-level fluency with Zendesk or an equivalent platform: views, triggers, macros, and routing logic.

Compensation

$144,000 - $216,000 USD

Depending on your location, an Applicant Privacy Notice may apply to you. You can find all of our Applicant Privacy Notices here.

Role Overview

As one of Harvey’s founding SMB Account Executives, you'll play a pivotal role in driving growth within the legal and professional services markets. You will be responsible for establishing new business relationships with small law firms and in-house legal teams, deeply understanding their challenges, and delivering AI solutions that transform how they work. By combining a high-velocity sales motion with a consultative, solution-driven approach, you’ll set the foundation for how we win in SMB and create long term impact for our clients. We’re looking for someone who thrives in fast-paced, early-stage environments, is energized by building from scratch, and is passionate about bringing Harvey’s mission to life.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Own your book of business by prioritizing warm leads and a named account list to maintain a high velocity sales motion.

  • Manage the new business lifecycle from prospecting to qualifying, validating Harvey’s solution, and contracting.

  • Achieve and exceed revenue targets and other key sales metrics.

  • Build strong relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders, understanding their pain points and aligning Harvey's solutions with their needs.

  • Conduct high velocity, tailored client evaluations, including product demonstrations and presentations.

  • Effectively work cross-functionally across the organization to shape Harvey’s solutions to meet SMB customer needs. Collaborate closely with the engineering and product teams to stay updated on the latest AI advancements and tailor solutions to meet client goals.

  • Proactively develop tactics, collateral, and messaging to improve the SMB team’s performance, documenting learnings that can be applied across accounts.

 

What You Have

  • Proven track record of selling complex software solutions, with the ability to successfully execute on a consultative, solutions-oriented, value-based selling methodology at high velocity.

  • Capable of independently leading a sales cycle from start to finish

  • Ability to independently manage a pipeline, accurately forecast key sales performance metrics, and consistently maintain CRM hygiene

  • Ability to lead a multi-threaded sale with executive stakeholders – especially the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

  • Demonstrated passion for Harvey’s mission and strong understanding of AI and its potential applications in knowledge work. Interest in the legal profession and helping lawyers do their jobs better and more efficiently.

  • Team player who can collaborate effectively across internal functions (product, legal, etc.) to achieve common goals.

  • Energized by contributing to the development of our team, sales processes, and culture, refining the value proposition of our solutions and creating sales resources to drive our success.

By combining a high-velocity sales motion with a consultative, solution-driven approach, you’ll set the foundation for how we win in SMB and create long term impact for our clients. We’re looking for someone who thrives in fast-paced, early-stage environments, is energized by building from scratch, and is passionate about bringing Harvey’s mission to life.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own your book of business by prioritizing warm leads and a named account list to maintain a high velocity sales motion.

 - Manage the new business lifecycle from prospecting to qualifying, validating Harvey’s solution, and contracting.

 - Achieve and exceed revenue targets and other key sales metrics.

 - Build strong relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders, understanding their pain points and aligning Harvey's solutions with their needs.

 - Conduct high velocity, tailored client evaluations, including product demonstrations and presentations.

 - Effectively work cross-functionally across the organization to shape Harvey’s solutions to meet SMB customer needs. Collaborate closely with the engineering and product teams to stay updated on the latest AI advancements and tailor solutions to meet client goals.

 - Proactively develop tactics, collateral, and messaging to improve the SMB team’s performance, documenting learnings that can be applied across accounts.

 


WHAT YOU HAVE

 - Proven track record of selling complex software solutions, with the ability to successfully execute on a consultative, solutions-oriented, value-based selling methodology at high velocity.

 - Capable of independently leading a sales cycle from start to finish

 - Ability to independently manage a pipeline, accurately forecast key sales performance metrics, and consistently maintain CRM hygiene

 - Ability to lead a multi-threaded sale with executive stakeholders – especially the ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

 - Demonstrated passion for Harvey’s mission and strong understanding of AI and its potential applications in knowledge work. Interest in the legal profession and helping lawyers do their jobs better and more efficiently.

 - Team player who can collaborate effectively across internal functions (product, legal, etc.) to achieve common goals.

 - Energized by contributing to the development of our team, sales processes, and culture, refining the value proposition of our solutions and creating sales resources to drive our success.

Role Overview

The Content Marketing Manager will develop content that advances Harvey's brand and business goals across editorial, campaigns, and social. This person will turn company priorities, customer insights, and market opportunities into high-quality content, then work across teams to distribute it effectively and measure its impact. This is a role for a strong writer and editor who is equally comfortable shaping strategy and producing the work itself, and who can translate complex legal, technical, and product ideas into clear, compelling stories.

What You'll Do

  • Contribute to Harvey's editorial strategy and help execute the content roadmap set by the Head of Content and Social Strategy.

  • Write and edit content across formats, including website articles, guides, reports, thought leadership, social series, video scripts, and campaign copy.

  • Turn complex legal, technical, and product ideas into clear, compelling stories for Harvey's audiences.

  • Develop content-led campaigns in partnership with product marketing, demand generation, communications, social, and other teams.

  • Create distribution strategies that extend the reach and value of each major content asset.

  • Write planned social copy and captions connected to editorial content, campaigns, launches, and brand initiatives.

  • Partner with the SEO lead to apply search insights to content planning, development, and optimization.

  • Use audience and performance data to understand what is working and improve future content.

  • Maintain a consistent, distinctive Harvey voice across channels and formats.

  • Partner with Content Operations and Publishing to move work efficiently through production, review, and publication.

What You Have

  • 5+ years of experience in content marketing, editorial, or a closely related discipline, ideally in B2B technology, SaaS, or professional services.

  • Exceptional writing and editing skills, with a portfolio that demonstrates range across long-form editorial, thought leadership, campaign copy, and social.

  • A proven ability to translate complex or technical subject matter into clear, engaging narratives for sophisticated audiences.

  • Experience contributing to an editorial strategy and delivering against a content roadmap, taking ownership of high-quality output end to end.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with a track record of partnering with product marketing, demand generation, communications, and social teams.

  • Familiarity with SEO fundamentals and comfort using search insights to shape content.

  • Fluency with content performance metrics and the judgment to turn data into better editorial decisions.

  • A sharp eye for brand voice and the discipline to maintain it consistently across channels and formats.

Compensation

$164,000 - $225,000 USD

  • Own EMEA mid-market forecasting and pipeline health, providing accurate reporting to senior leadership.

  • Hire, coach, and retain top managerial talent; build a strong leadership bench across the region.

  • Partner with global mid-market leadership to localize and refine the sales playbook for EMEA markets.

  • Work cross-functionally with marketing, solutions engineering, legal, and customer success to ensure a cohesive customer experience across the region.

  • Represent EMEA mid-market in global planning cycles, headcount discussions, and strategic initiatives.


What You Have

  • 10+ years of B2B tech sales experience, including 4+ years managing and developing sales managers or senior individual contributors.

  • Demonstrated success leading a regional or multi-market sales organization in a high-growth, early-stage environment.

  • Strong track record of selling complex software to enterprise or mid-market clients using a consultative, value-based methodology.

  • Experience operating across EMEA markets, with an understanding of regional dynamics, buyer behaviors, and legal industry nuances.

  • Exceptional communication and executive presence — able to influence both frontline teams and senior stakeholders.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As a Staff or Senior Staff Software Engineer on the Product Engineering team at Harvey, you will own and lead engineering projects that span multiple Product Engineering teams and product lines. You'll work closely with our AI, Legal, and GTM teams to build secure systems that deliver value to our customers.

Product Engineering covers a lot of ground, and we're looking for engineers across multiple domains — backend, full stack, and AI. We want people who have built great products across consumer, enterprise, and everything in between, and who are excited about building the future of application layer and genAI products. You'll build both the surfaces where lawyers meet Harvey — web, mobile, and embedded experiences in Word, Outlook, and Slack — and the agentic capabilities that power them.

This role can be based in New York City or San Francisco, with a hybrid schedule of three days a week in office.

What You'll Do

  • Bring AI to where our customers already work: build Harvey across every surface — web, desktop, mobile, and embedded experiences (Google Docs, MS Word, Outlook, and Slack), and API.

  • Lead large, high-priority projects that span multiple teams, and define the technical bets we make over the next several quarters.

  • Find the problems that are business critical, prioritize ruthlessly, and make the big tradeoff calls without slowing anyone down.

  • Build AI-platform and AI-native capabilities — the agent harness, agent building (custom agents and workflows), tool calling, retrieval, memory and context management, personalization and tone, the thread experience, and the evals that turn model quality into product quality.

  • Ship the systems that make Harvey work: retrieval over petabyte-scale document corpora, ingestion growing 10x every six months, data collection across 50+ jurisdictions, and government-level security for the world's most sensitive matters.

  • Ship across the stack — React and TypeScript alongside Python and Postgres — architecting intuitive UX and robust APIs for streaming results, long-running processes, and complex tool-calling workflows.

  • Mentor senior and staff engineers, and raise the bar for how the whole org builds.

What You Have

  • 10+ YoE (post-BS/MS) in a product-focused software engineering role, operating at Staff level or above.

  • Depth in full stack, backend, or agents/AI — and enough range to be useful outside it.

  • Experience building scalable, extensible systems that support multiple product lines.

  • Track record of shipping highly intuitive products in fast-growing SaaS, strong attention to detail.

  • Experience with React, TypeScript, CSS (we use TailwindCSS), Python, or related. For agents/AI, proficiency in Python plus hands-on work building and shipping agentic systems — agent harnesses/loops, tool use, memory, and evals — not just calling LLM APIs.

  • You embrace AI in how you build: AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar) are a core part of how you ship, and you have sharp instincts for where they accelerate work and where they fall short.

  • A history of influencing and aligning engineers and leaders well outside your direct scope.

  • Strong programming skills and general Computer Science knowledge.

  • Grit — experience working at early-stage startups is a plus.

Compensation

$231,000 – $340,000 USD

Depending on your location, an Applicant Privacy Notice may apply to you. You can find all of our Applicant Privacy Notices here.

This is a high-impact, cross-functional role for a commercially minded lawyer who wants to sit at the intersection of law, brand, and go-to-market strategy.

What You'll Do

  • Review and advise on marketing language across all promotional material, product announcements, including web copy, advertising, social media, email campaigns, sales enablement content, and event and press materials, to ensure claims are accurate, substantiated, and compliant.

  • Balance commercial, marketing, compliance, and privacy concerns across advertising campaigns (US and internationally).

  • Advise on targeted and digital advertising practices, including the data, privacy, tracking of direct to consumer marketing such as email marketing.

  • Act as the embedded legal partner to Marketing and Comms leadership, providing practical, business-oriented guidance that enables campaigns to launch quickly and responsibly.

  • Partner closely with cross-functional teams to keep pace in a fast-moving environment, knowing when to move independently and when to escalate matters to the right internal stakeholders.

  • Collaborate with the commercial team on global marketing agreements.

What You Have

  • J.D. and active membership in good standing with at least one U.S. state bar.

  • 8+ years of relevant experience at a law firm and/or in-house, with meaningful exposure to marketing, advertising, and commercial contracting.

  • Strong command of advertising and marketing law, including claims substantiation, and consumer protection.

  • Working knowledge of privacy and data protection issues relevant to targeted advertising and direct-to-consumer marketing.

  • Demonstrated ability to draft and negotiate a high volume of marketing commercial agreements independently.

  • Excellent judgment, a business-first mindset, and the ability to give clear, practical advice under tight timelines.

  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and partnering closely with non-legal stakeholders.

As a Mid Market Customer Success Manager at Harvey, you will own value realization for customers, helping to define the future of legal work at top enterprises and leading law firms. You’ll act as a trusted expert and guide customers through the process of integrating AI into the daily workflows of lawyers and other professionals. You will not only help customers to identify use cases for Harvey, but also help transform the practice of law. You’ll deeply integrate Harvey into your customers' business processes and workflows, build lasting relationships, and partner with Account Executives to renew and expand Harvey’s strategic partnerships.

What You’ll Do

  • Onboarding: Integrate Harvey into customer workflows, guide administrators with data-backed best practices, ensure optimal use of our AI solutions.

  • Training & Enablement: Champion the power of Harvey as you meet with end users and position Harvey as essential to strategic legal work.

  • Relationships: Navigate complex organizations as the primary contact, foster champions, engage executive buyers, and build loyal Harvey advocates.

  • Success Metrics: Align with customers on adoption rates, measurable value, and positive AI experiences to ensure customer value realization and ROI.

  • Expansion and Renewal: Collaborate with Account Executives to maintain customer renewal readiness and leverage customer needs to drive expansions.

  • Product Feedback: Represent customer needs internally and relay insights back to Product and Engineering, continuously improving the Harvey platform

What You Have

Ideal candidates for the Mid Market CSM role at Harvey can demonstrate comfort and experience with the following qualifications:

  • 3-4+ years in customer-owning roles at tech or SaaS platforms

  • Managing a high volume of customer-facing projects and timelines

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

Spaces bring people, context, and agents together in one place. They help legal teams organize their work, collaborate securely, and use Harvey across the lifecycle of a matter or project.

We’re looking for a Senior or Staff Product Manager to own the core Spaces experience. You will shape how users create and navigate Spaces, bring in relevant context, run work, and return to Spaces as an ongoing part of their workflow. You’ll also lead the work required to make the product intuitive, polished, and broadly adopted across Harvey’s customers.

This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone with excellent product judgment, strong design instincts, and the ability to turn an ambitious, ambiguous problem into a clear strategy and shipped product.

What You'll Do

  • Own the core Spaces experience: Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for how users organize and conduct their work in Spaces.

  • Simplify complex workflows: Create intuitive experiences and mental models across navigation, information architecture, resources, activity, and agents.

  • Drive product quality: Work closely with Design and Engineering to raise the craft bar, resolve friction, and make the end-to-end experience feel coherent, polished, and delightful.

  • Grow adoption: Improve onboarding, activation, entry points, defaults, and repeat usage. Establish clear success metrics and use data and research to guide iteration.

  • Lead product development end to end: Take problems from discovery and definition through launch, measurement, and continued improvement.

  • Stay close to customers: Spend meaningful time with law firms, in-house legal teams, and end users to understand how they work and translate their needs into opinionated product decisions.

  • Work across Harvey: Partner with adjacent product teams so Spaces fits naturally with the rest of the Harvey platform.

What You Have

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including meaningful ownership of a major user-facing product or core product experience.

  • A track record of building excellent B2B SaaS, productivity, workflow, collaboration, or knowledge-management products.

  • Strong product and design judgment, with demonstrated experience simplifying complex workflows or information architecture.

  • Experience taking products through both early definition and subsequent scaling, adoption, and refinement.

  • Strong growth instincts and experience improving activation, onboarding, engagement, or retention.

  • The ability to operate with high agency in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment and independently drive work from problem to outcome.

  • Deep customer orientation and the judgment to translate customer feedback into broadly useful product decisions.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership and the ability to influence Engineering, Design, GTM, and other partners.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building multi-user workspaces or products involving sharing and collaboration.

  • Experience with enterprise complexity, including different user types, permissions, governance, or sensitive data.

  • Experience building AI-powered products or designing workflows involving AI agents.

  • Experience working at a high-growth technology company.

Compensation

$177,700 - $266,500 USD

Role Overview

The Head of Global Recruiting Operations will lead the systems, programs, and processes that power and accelerate recruiting across every function and region. The Recruiting team's mission is to identify, attract, and hire world-class talent, and this role ensures the operational and programmatic infrastructure supports this goal. This position oversees the recruiting operating model end to end: coordination, systems, analytics, programs and enablement that support our hiring teams and ambitions hiring goals, ensuring a coherent model for a global organization. This leader will partner cross functionally and with recruiting leadership to translate hiring plans into consistent, well run execution. It is an exciting opportunity to operationalize talent acquisition at scale in an AI native environment.

What You'll Do

  • Partner proactively with business leadership and the recruiting team to translate long term business objectives into a unified, high impact global recruiting operations strategy

  • Develop and drive recruiting programs that align with the overall recruiting strategy

  • Drive strategic alignment across recruiting technology, operational workflows, and automation initiatives to directly support overarching organizational priorities

  • Collaborate with recruiting leaders to champion excellence, consistent standards, and strategic capability building across all hiring teams

  • Lead integrated workforce and demand planning in lockstep with Finance and business heads, steering executive decision-making and strategic capacity planning globally

  • Drive the continued development of a strategic talent analytics function to provide business leaders and recruiting executives with actionable guidance, pipeline foresight, and high-level productivity insights

  • Influence and elevate candidate experience and hiring manager engagement through world class programs and enablement

What You Have

  • 10+ years leading recruiting operations, systems, and enablement teams in global, high-growth organizations.

  • Demonstrated success in translating overarching business goals into comprehensive recruiting strategies, executive analytics frameworks, and scalable operational models.

Harvey’s in‑house legal team is a global group of lawyers and legal professionals operating across multiple disciplines. As we expand across EMEA, we are looking for a privacy lawyer to join our growing legal team. You will play a key role, working directly with our Head of Privacy, in maintaining and promoting a culture of privacy and security within the organization. In this role you will collaborate closely with legal colleagues in the commercial team and our sales/ Go-To-Market team, advise the engineering and product teams to ensure that our business practices adhere to privacy laws and regulations globally, and partner closely with the security function to safeguard and maintain the integrity of our data.

 

What You'll Do

  • Assist in drafting, reviewing, and negotiating Data Processing Agreements with our customers, subprocessors, service providers, and third-parties.

  • Help develop, maintain, and scale global privacy programs. This includes preparing Data Protection Impact Assessments to identify and mitigate privacy risks and Records of Processing in accordance with regulatory requirements.

  • Work cross functionally with talented product and engineering teams in evaluating the impact of privacy and data protection laws and regulatory guidance on exciting product developments.

  • Monitor and respond to changes in privacy laws and regulations, including AI regulations.

  • Support implementation and ongoing compliance with AI-specific regulation, including the EU AI Act, UK AI governance frameworks, and related guidance.

  • Assist in classification of AI systems, assessment of risk obligations, and development of internal AI governance controls, documentation, and processes.

  • Partner with legal, product, and compliance stakeholders on AI principles such as transparency, accountability, and human-oversight.


What You Have

  • Qualified lawyer with 4+ years of post-qualification experience in privacy and data protection

  • Proven expertise in EU and U.S. data protection law, with familiarity across global compliance frameworks

  • Excellent drafting and negotiation skills, with the confidence to represent Harvey on matters relating to data privacy, AI, and security

  • Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across legal and business teams

  • Highly responsive and detail-oriented, with the ability to balance strategic thinking and hands-on execution

 

Depending on your location, an Applicant Privacy Notice may apply to you. You can find all of our Applicant Privacy Notices here.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Counsel- Marketing to join Harvey's growing legal team. In this role you will be the primary legal point of contact for all marketing and communications activity at Harvey. You will also assist with the contracts and commercial relationships that power our marketing engine, safeguard the integrity of our promotional messaging, and act as a hands-on partner to the teams driving Harvey's growth. This is a high-impact, cross-functional role for a commercially minded lawyer who wants to sit at the intersection of law, brand, and go-to-market strategy.

What You'll Do

  • Review and advise on marketing language across all promotional material, product announcements, including web copy, advertising, social media, email campaigns, sales enablement content, and event and press materials, to ensure claims are accurate, substantiated, and compliant.

  • Balance commercial, marketing, compliance, and privacy concerns across advertising campaigns (US and internationally).

  • Advise on targeted and digital advertising practices, including the data, privacy, tracking of direct to consumer marketing such as email marketing.

  • Act as the embedded legal partner to Marketing and Comms leadership, providing practical, business-oriented guidance that enables campaigns to launch quickly and responsibly.

  • Partner closely with cross-functional teams to keep pace in a fast-moving environment, knowing when to move independently and when to escalate matters to the right internal stakeholders.

  • Collaborate with the commercial team on global marketing agreements.

What You Have

  • J.D. and active membership in good standing with at least one U.S. state bar.

  • 8+ years of relevant experience at a law firm and/or in-house, with meaningful exposure to marketing, advertising, and commercial contracting.

  • Strong command of advertising and marketing law, including claims substantiation, and consumer protection.

  • Working knowledge of privacy and data protection issues relevant to targeted advertising and direct-to-consumer marketing.

  • Demonstrated ability to draft and negotiate a high volume of marketing commercial agreements independently.

  • Excellent judgment, a business-first mindset, and the ability to give clear, practical advice under tight timelines.

  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and partnering closely with non-legal stakeholders.

Compensation

$210,300 - $281,500 USD

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

We are seeking an SMB Account Executive to drive commercial growth across Australia and New Zealand, focused on the small and medium law firm segment. SMB at Harvey means law firms with between 5 and 15 lawyers on staff (excluding support staff and paralegals); we estimate roughly a quarter of all lawyers globally work at SMB-sized firms. This is a founding role on a new segment for the region — a chance to leave a mark, help develop our playbook, and provide valuable feedback directly to product leadership.

You will be joining as a founding member of our Sydney team.

What you'll do

  • Own and grow a territory of SMB accounts across ANZ, driving full-funnel sales activity from prospecting through to commercial negotiation and onboarding.

  • Manage a high-velocity pipeline, selling annual commitments to law firm buyers with an average deal cycle of approximately 30 days.

  • Sell consultatively to Partners and Managing Partners at small law firms, understanding their pain points and tailoring solutions to their priorities.

  • Lead high-impact product demos and client meetings that clearly articulate Harvey's business value and technical capabilities.

  • Run disciplined qualification, discovery, objection handling, and closing, applying methodologies such as MEDDIC or Challenger.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, legal, engineering, and go-to-market teams to surface client needs and inform the roadmap.

  • Document learnings, iterate on messaging, and help build scalable processes to accelerate regional growth.

What we're looking for

  • Closing experience, ideally in complex B2B SaaS sales cycles within the mid-market or enterprise segments.

  • Proven success in qualification, discovery, objection handling, and closing, with the ability to build multi-threaded relationships and navigate org charts.

  • Strong analytical ability and structured thinking, with clear, credible communication to senior stakeholders.

  • Coachability and humility — growth-minded, open to feedback, and comfortable operating in a fast-evolving environment with limited structure.

  • Genuine interest in the legal industry and a commitment to enhancing knowledge work through technology.

  • Familiarity with sales practices in the ANZ region is a plus.

Additional information

  • Location: Sydney, NSW (hybrid — 3 days in the Sydney office, 2 days working from home).

  • Work eligibility: Must have valid Australian work rights; Harvey does not currently offer visa sponsorship for this role.

What we offer

  • The chance to be a founding member of our Sydney team and help build a new segment.

  • A structured hybrid working arrangement.

  • Enterprise-level exposure and a clear path to progress toward an Enterprise AE role.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

Harvey is hiring a Senior Motion Designer to define how motion shows up across Harvey’s brand, product storytelling, launch moments, web experiences, customer education, and executive-facing creative work. The role will sit within Brand and Design, reporting into our Head of Motion. This is a new senior IC role intended to raise the motion craft bar while still operating with the low-ego, hands-on generalist posture expected of Harvey’s senior brand hires. The role should build on existing motion and brand hiring standards, including deep portfolio review, visible process, cross-functional collaboration with PMM and Marketing, and practical assessment of prioritization under ambiguity. The person in this role will help Harvey turn complex AI product ideas into clear, memorable, and reusable motion systems that can scale across product launches, web surfaces, campaign assets, Academy or education assets, events, and internal/external storytelling.

What You’ll Do

Support the motion design language for Harvey’s brand across launch videos, product explainers, web and campaign moments, event assets, social cuts, sales enablement, and other high-leverage creative surfaces.

Create motion concepts, storyboards, style-frames, animatics, and final motion assets that make complex AI workflows feel clear, premium, and unmistakably Harvey.

Partner closely with Brand, Product Marketing, Product Design, Creative Operations, and other GTM stakeholders to translate positioning, product context, and user needs into motion narratives that can ship quickly.

Develop reusable motion systems, templates, animation principles, and production workflows so Harvey can scale motion output without reinventing the wheel on every request.

Use judgment to scope work appropriately across polished hero moments, scrappy launch needs, quick-turnaround edits, and longer-term brand-system investments.

Raise the craft bar for motion while remaining willing to do the unglamorous but important production work required in a fast-moving creative team.

What You Have

Experience building motion for brand, product, marketing, launch, or education contexts, ideally in a product-led technology company or high-growth SaaS environment.

A strong portfolio of motion work that demonstrates storytelling, art direction, animation craft, visual systems thinking, and the ability to explain the process behind finished work.

Deep fluency in motion design tools and workflows such as After Effects, Figma, Cinema 4D, Lottie, Rive, code-adjacent motion, or comparable production tools.

A demonstrated ability to simplify complex concepts visually without overloading the viewer, including strong instincts for pacing, sequencing, hierarchy, narration, and accessibility.

Strong cross-functional communication skills, including the ability to clarify a brief, align with PMM or Marketing goals, handle competing feedback, and prioritize multiple stakeholder requests.

Compensation

$136,000 - $187,000

Use judgment to scope work appropriately across polished hero moments, scrappy launch needs, quick-turnaround edits, and longer-term brand-system investments.

Raise the craft bar for motion while remaining willing to do the unglamorous but important production work required in a fast-moving creative team.

 


WHAT YOU HAVE

Experience building motion for brand, product, marketing, launch, or education contexts, ideally in a product-led technology company or high-growth SaaS environment.

A strong portfolio of motion work that demonstrates storytelling, art direction, animation craft, visual systems thinking, and the ability to explain the process behind finished work.

Deep fluency in motion design tools and workflows such as After Effects, Figma, Cinema 4D, Lottie, Rive, code-adjacent motion, or comparable production tools.

A demonstrated ability to simplify complex concepts visually without overloading the viewer, including strong instincts for pacing, sequencing, hierarchy, narration, and accessibility.

Strong cross-functional communication skills, including the ability to clarify a brief, align with PMM or Marketing goals, handle competing feedback, and prioritize multiple stakeholder requests.





COMPENSATION

$136,000 - $187,000

We’re looking for an experienced, hands-on Field Marketing Manager to own and execute our field marketing strategy. You’ll lead the planning and delivery of first-party and third-party events, regional activations, and integrated campaigns designed to drive pipeline, lead generation, and revenue impact across the US market.

This is an individual contributor role for a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, evolving environment and partners closely with GTM. You’ll be expected to build programs and processes from the ground up, continuously iterate and improve how we operate, and roll up your sleeves to execute—from developing the strategy and playbooks to being on the ground making it happen.

What You'll Do

  • Own the planning and execution of US field marketing programs, including first-party events (executive dinners, roundtables, happy hours, and experiential events) and third-party events (conferences, sponsorships, partner activations).

  • Partner closely with the US GTM team to develop territory-based and account-focused event strategies, including pre- and post-event engagement and follow-up.

  • Manage end-to-end event delivery, including budgets, logistics, vendors, agencies, on-site execution, and post-event reporting.

  • Lead the development of scalable field marketing playbooks, processes, and best practices to support growth and consistency globally.

  • Own and manage relationships with external agencies, event partners, and third-party organizers, ensuring high-quality delivery and strong ROI.

  • Track, analyze, and report on the performance of field marketing activities, using data and insights to continuously improve impact and efficiency.


What You Have

  • 4–7 years of experience in field marketing, event marketing, or demand generation within B2B SaaS or professional services.

  • Proven ability to deliver high-impact field events and activations that drive measurable pipeline and lead generation.

  • Strong experience partnering with Sales on territory-based or account-focused marketing initiatives.

  • Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills, with a high bar for execution and detail.

  • Familiarity with tools such as Salesforce, Marketo (or similar), and event platforms is highly desirable.

  • Experience marketing to legal, financial services, consulting, or other high-touch professional audiences is a plus.

As an Enterprise Customer Success Manager, you’ll play a critical role in guiding our clients through their journey with Harvey, and help define the future of work at top enterprises and leading Law Firms. You'll act as a trusted advisor, deeply integrating Harvey into their business processes and workflows.

What You'll Do

  • Strategic Implementation: Lead the integration of Harvey into client workflows, ensuring seamless adoption and optimal use of our AI solutions.

  • Training & Enablement: Evangelize the power of LLMs as you meet with and enable end users to adopt Harvey on a daily-basis as it becomes a “must have” product.

  • Client Relationship Management: Serve as the primary contact for clients with a prescriptive and consultative approach and serving as a thought partner to deliver a superior customer experience.

  • Success Metrics Management: Leverage adoption rates, utilization metrics, and other KPIs to drive strategies ensuring client satisfaction and high ROI.

  • Advocacy and Engagement: Encourage user and stakeholder engagement, transforming them into Harvey advocates within their organizations.

  • Customer Health Monitoring: Use analytics and feedback to maintain customer satisfaction, ensuring readiness for renewal and expansion opportunities.

  • Feedback Loop: Relay client insights back to our internal teams, aiding in the continuous improvement of our product and services.

  • Travel may be required from time to time, including visits to customer office locations and company offices.

What You Have

  • Experienced professionals with a background in Enterprise SaaS, legal (big law) or top tier management consulting firms and direct experience managing large-scale technology projects.

  • Individuals with excellent communication and strategic planning skills, capable of influencing stakeholders at various levels.

  • Results driven candidates who are able to ruthlessly prioritize competing tasks and demanding customers seamlessly

  • Team players described as committed, collaborative and proactive with a team-first mentality.

What We Offer

  • An opportunity to contribute to the growth and direction of our rapidly-evolving Customer Success program, building out best-in-class playbooks and processes.

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly skilled solicitor to lead our EMEA Commercial legal team. Reporting to the Deputy General Counsel, you will primarily interface with our Go-To-Market team to help ensure the fast, efficient execution of our agreements with customers, and you will also have exposure to product, privacy and competition issues.

What You'll Do

Generative AI has the power to greatly change the world and directly impact how things get done. Harvey is at the forefront of this change, and our mission is to make generative AI actionable and useful for our customers. This is a fast moving environment (we are a start-up!) that is serving some of the world’s most renowned law firms and professional organizations. And this role will put you in the center of all of this.

More specifically, you will:

  • Lead the international multi-office Commercial legal function in the UK and EU, continuing to build a strong substantive, organizational and relationship foundation for the legal presence in the region

  • Mentor and lead a high-functioning team (including managers) in the drafting, review, and negotiation Commercial AI SaaS contracts

  • Hire others in the region as we expand


What You Have

  • UK or Dublin-based solicitor with 12+ years experience, both with the commercial or technology division of a leading private practice law firm, and subsequently in-house with a technology company supporting SaaS or technology Go-To-Market or Business Development teams

  • Experience building and managing high-functioning teams

  • Transactional background, including with technology and/or IP licensing commercial agreements

  • Experience with government sales is a plus, as is working internationally with US-based leadership

  • Ability to think creatively, function independently and work proactively in a fast-paced environment

  • Team-focused and collaborative work style; willingness to build expertise and solve new challenges in an evolving practice

  • Hyper-responsive and service-oriented attitude

  • Bonus qualifications include experience with AI, and a love for solving hard problems with a small tight-knit team

The Senior Technical Program Manager, GTM Technology leads delivery of cross-functional programs for Harvey's go-to-market systems. They join the program management team in Business Technology, Harvey's IT organization. This role ensures multi-team GTM technology programs are well planned, coordinated across teams, and delivered on time. They work with GTM systems and integrations teams to deliver programs for Sales, Marketing, Product, and Finance. It is an opportunity to deliver high-impact programs at an AI-native company as an early member of a growing program management team.

What You'll Do

  • Own end-to-end delivery of Business Technology's most strategic lead-to-cash programs, from planning through launch and retrospective.

  • Align cross-functional program teams on scope, sequencing, and milestones for programs that span CRM, marketing automation, sales engagement, and CPQ.

  • Coordinate delivery across Business Technology's GTM systems and integrations teams to keep programs on plan.

  • Surface risks, dependencies, and trade-offs early, and drive them to decisions with the right owners.

  • Give leadership clear visibility into program health through concise written updates, without adding overhead for delivery teams.

  • Contribute to shared, AI-enabled program practices that help the team deliver faster as Business Technology scales.

What You Have

  • 8+ years of experience in technical program management or a related role, with a track record of delivering complex, cross-functional GTM systems programs at high-growth B2B SaaS companies.

  • Experience leading at least one quote-to-cash, CRM, CPQ, or billing systems program end to end.

  • Working knowledge of GTM systems such as Salesforce and how they connect, enough to understand trade-offs and ask the right questions of systems teams.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Product, and Finance without direct authority.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to distill complex programs into clear narratives for executive audiences.

  • Sound judgment on process and comfort with ambiguity. You right-size structure to the program and default to simple, AI-enabled ways of working.

Compensation

$150,000 - $205,000 USD

jobs.title: Technical CX Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As a Technical Customer Experience (CX) Specialist, you will be the frontline support within the global support team, reporting to the CX Manager. Your role is crucial in providing empathetic and efficient support to our customers. We are seeking someone who loves problem-solving, is adept at handling multiple priorities, and is passionate about working with enterprise customers to ensure a seamless support experience.

 

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the first point of contact for customer support inquiries, delivering empathetic, accurate, and timely resolutions.

  • Juggle multiple competing priorities and tasks, ensuring a high level of service and responsiveness.

  • Troubleshoot issues including AI output quality, app login, feature requests, REST APIs, error logs, and authentication/token issues.

  • Maintain a high standard of reliability and accountability, ensuring consistent coverage and follow-through during assigned shifts.

  • Collaborate with team members to troubleshoot complex issues, escalating them appropriately when needed.

  • Maintain a deep understanding of our products and services to provide knowledgeable support.

  • Document customer interactions and feedback to aid in continuous improvement of our services.

  • Work closely with other departments to resolve customer issues and contribute to the overall customer experience.

  • Collaborate effectively as part of a team while confidently owning and executing tasks independently.

  • Stay informed of new product features and updates to provide accurate and current support.

  • Contribute to the development and refinement of support processes and materials, such as FAQs and knowledge base articles.

 

What You Have

  • 3+ years proven experience in a technical support role, in a fast-paced environment providing “white glove” or “premium support” to large enterprise customers for AI-driven products

  • Exceptional empathy and a genuine desire to help and connect with customers.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to think creatively and resolve complex issues.

  • Excellent organisational skills, capable of managing multiple tasks and priorities effectively.

  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to convey complex information in an understandable manner.

  • Understanding of APIs, and ability to explain complex API concepts to both technical and non-technical customers.

  • Familiarity with customer support tools and CRM systems; experience with Intercom is a plus.

  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and build positive working relationships across departments.

  • A passion for learning and personal growth, with a commitment to staying informed about industry trends and best practices.

 

"This role is open to remote candidates located in: California, Oregon, Utah, Washington, Wisconsin”

 
 

Depending on your location, an Applicant Privacy Notice may apply to you. You can find all of our Applicant Privacy Notices [here].

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

Harvey's law school program has reached 50+ US schools in year one. Now we are taking it global, and we need the right person to lead that charge expanding in the EMEA, and APAC markets.

As International Law School Manager, EMEA you will own the full lifecycle of Harvey's academic partnerships across your markets — signing new schools, building faculty and dean relationships, running trainings, launching ambassador programs, and driving the curriculum and on-campus embeds that make Harvey helpful to each institution with whom we work.

You will start by taking over account management of existing EMEA partner schools and then look to sign and expand our presence across the region. You report directly to the Head of Legal Partnerships, Law Schools (New York).

What You'll Do

  • School Partnerships: Lead outreach, relationship development, and onboarding for EMEA law schools — from flagship institutions to smaller schools.

  • Market Expansion: Build the playbook for Harvey’s Academic presence in each new EMEA/International market together with Law School Lead; execute new international launches throughout the year.

  • Cross-functional: Partner with Harvey's GTM commercial team, legal engineering, and marketing on in-market events, firm-to-school pipeline, and co-activation opportunities.

  • Account Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for every school in your portfolio — owning relationships with faculty, library staff, student organizations, and administrators across each partner institution.

  • Training & Enablement: Run all product training, demos, workspace setup, and activation events for your portfolio — including semester-start all-hands pushes, large-group faculty workshops, and 1:1 curriculum advisory sessions. Draw on the global Content Specialist and CS Lead for materials and operational support.

  • Ambassador Programs: Launch and own the EMEA student ambassador and faculty champion networks, adapting the US/UK model for European legal education norms.

  • Curriculum Advisory: Advise faculty and curriculum committees on how to integrate Harvey into courses, clinics, and legal writing programs — doing the hands-on work that makes academic embeds real.

What You Have

Ideal candidates for the Law School Manager, EMEA role at Harvey can demonstrate comfort and experience with the following:

  • Law degree preferred — deep understanding of how EMEA law schools are structured and how faculty, students, and administrators operate

  • Strong experience in legal practice, legal tech, legal innovation, or academic programs — experience in a client-facing or externally-facing role is a strong differentiator

  • Proven ability to manage a portfolio of relationships in a high-growth or startup environment — you keep up with a high volume without losing account depth

  • Comfortable running product trainings and demos for audiences ranging from first-year students to senior faculty and deans

  • Entrepreneurial and self-directed — you build from scratch, operate without a playbook, and hold yourself accountable across multiple markets

  • Strong organizational instincts — you can manage many schools across multiple countries and time zones.

  • Based in London, Paris, or Madrid, 3 days a week in office; Willing and able to travel across Europe, US, and other international jurisdictions for work.

Depending on your location, an Applicant Privacy Notice may apply to you. You can find all of our Applicant Privacy Notices here.

As International Law School Manager, EMEA you will own the full lifecycle of Harvey's academic partnerships across your markets — signing new schools, building faculty and dean relationships, running trainings, launching ambassador programs, and driving the curriculum and on-campus embeds that make Harvey helpful to each institution with whom we work.

Draw on the global Content Specialist and CS Lead for materials and operational support.

 - Curriculum Advisory: Advise faculty and curriculum committees on how to integrate Harvey into courses, clinics, and legal writing programs — doing the hands-on work that makes academic embeds real.




WHAT YOU HAVE



Ideal candidates for the Law School Manager, EMEA role at Harvey can demonstrate comfort and experience with the following:

 - Law degree preferred — deep understanding of how EMEA law schools are structured and how faculty, students, and administrators operate
